claims.assertion: Anéeka describes a shipboard museum containing artifacts from Earth and several extraterrestrial cultures, including Urmah armor and Zeta controls.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says most objects are believed original.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says collecting souvenirs from visited worlds is common among crews, especially on large ships.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says crews acquire items by collecting or receiving gifts.

review_flags: The source is an unverified account of extraterrestrial shipboard life and artifact collections.
coverage_gaps: The interview also describes the museum’s layout and the ships’ passenger accommodations.
